assets.title: Fixed Ironing Board and Iron Kit
assets.description: Original static low-poly ironing kit with a tapered cloth-covered board, genuinely offset crossed steel legs and fixed connecting pins on two grounded crossbars. A separate editable iron has a continuous thin sole, tapered shell and a real through-opening handle, displayed flat on the board. Board cover top is 0.885 m; this is one functional kit rather than repeated iron variants. No folding, heating, electrical operation, cloth simulation, load rating or ergonomic certification.

assets.title: Static Lockstitch Sewing Workstation
assets.description: Original static low-poly sewing workstation: 1.00 by 0.56 m dedicated tabletop at 0.79 m, with an actual bed aperture, recessed machine bed and continuous C-shaped casing with open sewing throat. Handwheel and axle, needle bar, smaller needle, visible presser foot and plate, plain spool and fixed foot treadle are distinct editable parts. An unchanged existing dining chair is separately tested at a documented seated display pose. No needle, pedal, motor or cloth simulation, sewing capability, load rating or ergonomic certification.
